analyst_view.overall: Early view: PSG visit Toulouse on a Friday night between the Lorient home game and a Champions League trip to Aston Villa on 8 December. Some of PSG's injured players (Dembele, Marquinhos, Nuno Mendes) may be back by then, but Kvaratskhelia's knee injury is long term; Toulouse are mid-table under Jens Berthel Askou and lean on a physical, set-piece-heavy game.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. I stay with that: PSG score 2.2 a game and Toulouse have conceded 14 in 10, but Toulouse were described as toothless for 45 minutes even in their 3-1 win over Strasbourg. Whether PSG's injured attackers are back will decide whether this drifts higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. I lean slightly higher: PSG win 5.5 corners a game and Toulouse 4.3, and Toulouse will want set pieces, where Mark McKenzie scored against Strasbourg. Nine or ten seems more likely.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.0 cards. I lean higher: Toulouse commit the second-most fouls in Ligue 1 (15.8 a game), and chasing PSG's passing usually produces bookings for the home side. PSG themselves foul little, so most cards should go to Toulouse.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.2 shots. PSG's 19.3 a game plus Toulouse's usual output against top sides fits that, so I stay put. Rotation before Aston Villa is the main thing that could pull it down.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target. That looks reasonable: PSG average 7.8 on target, the most in the league. I would revisit it once PSG's injury list for December is clearer.
